LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_CycleDescription: Remove every drug addiction and drug tolerance from the occupant. Withdrawal ends with the addiction that causes it.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_LetterText: {0} has completed detox treatment in the biosculpter pod. Every drug addiction and drug tolerance that could be treated has been removed.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_NoConditionsLetterText: {0} has completed the detox cycle, but had nothing the cycle could treat. The cycle had no effect.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_NoConditionsToTreat: There is nothing this cycle can treat, so it cannot be started.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_PermanentAddictionsTrea: Permanent addictions such as luciferium will be treated.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_PermanentAddictionsSkip: Permanent addictions such as luciferium will not be treated.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_CureIncurableAddictions: A permanent addiction is one the game itself marks as impossible to cure. Luciferium is the only one in the base game. Turn this on to let the detox cycle remove them.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_CycleDurationTooltip: How long a pawn stays in the pod for one detox cycle. The default is {0}. A cycle that has already started keeps the length it started with.
